name: medha-workspace
description: medha: evidential-memory engine as a library. Four packages (core, store, sync, sage) with enforced boundaries. Self-contained so the whole directory can be extracted to its own repo.

scripts.boundaries: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs sage-core/src sage-store/src sage-sync/src sage/src cli/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run test
